AGENT_NAME.consumer: Image/entrypoint integration contract; memory gates and WebUI integrations may read this identifier. Preserve it; the selected deployment image must verify its own consumers.

HERMES_HOME.consumer: Hermes hermes_constants.py:get_hermes_home and get_hermes_home_override; scaffold mount services.<service>.volumes[target=/runtime].

TERMINAL_CWD.consumer: Hermes tools/terminal_tool.py:_safe_getcwd and terminal environment setup; cli.py terminal config bridge can override it; scaffold mount services.<service>.volumes[target=/workspace].
